verdict.rationale: The Secretary of State documents a registered-agent rail. It covers appointing or changing an entity's registered agent and a separate Commercial Registered Agent registration for agents representing more than 10 companies. That is a sanctioned third-party channel acting for companies, but the evidence is only form and listing titles. It does not show what such providers may file or do on the company's behalf. Missing for 10: documentation of the scope of agent or designee authority (e.g., filing on behalf of the entity), any authorized-filer or representative access model for business filings, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the service documents a sanctioned third-party rail — designees, authorized providers, registered agents, or representatives — through which a provider can act for my company
